verdict.rationale: DOM-manipulation escape hatches are a fair axis for a UI library, but the pack never documents refs, effects, or any way for a component to hand a DOM node to a charting or visualization library. The cited material covers adjacent topics only: mounting React into a DOM node via createRoot/hydrateRoot, and adding React to an existing page. A community comment notes React abstracts the DOM itself, which does not show direct manipulation either.
